constraints: If menu is a MenuRef (string), the process parameter serves no purpose and is ignored.

Unless the trailing '*' is passed, itemText uses a mini-grammar of metacharacters: ';' separates multiple item labels in one call; a leading '(' disables the item; "-" or "(-" creates a separator line; '<B'/'<I'/'<U' set bold/italic/underline style; '!' followed by a character sets a check-mark character; '^' followed by a character selects a Mac OS icon resource (code + 208); '/' followed by a character sets a keyboard shortcut.
When the trailing '*' is passed, all of those metacharacters (including ';') are treated as literal standard characters instead, which also means only one menu item can be created per call.
Newly appended items have no associated method/action; SET MENU ITEM PROPERTY or SET MENU ITEM METHOD (or Menu selected in a form method) must be used to wire them up.
subMenu must be an existing menu reference (e.g. created with Create menu); if the call appends more than one item, the submenu is attached to the first one.
